title: Open: networks, content, partial states, relation to other theories

statements.text: Which networks compute the schema, what exactly it contains, whether it can be partial or is all or nothing, and how it relates to global workspace and higher-order theories are open questions, some under experimental study.

sources.quote: The theory may have many gaps. For example, what networks in the brain compute this information? What exactly is the informational content of the attention schema?
